The user wants to know the expected fare for an economy class ticket from the first airport to the second one in the system's list, on date 2026-11-15. We need to get the list of all airports via list_all_airports. Then pick the first and second airports from that list. Then call get_flight_cost with travel_from=first airport code, travel_to=second airport code, travel_date='2026-11-15', travel_class='economy'.

We have no prior authentication; but get_flight_cost does not require authentication. So we can directly call get_flight_cost.

Thus we should call get_flight_cost with appropriate arguments. But we need to get the list of airports first. That requires calling list_all_airports. So we need to do two calls: list_all_airports then get_flight_cost. We'll do them sequentially.
